CustomField.description: Semicolon-separated list of parent record field values for which this Prefix Option should appear in the c-file-loader combobox. Leave blank to always show the option. Each token must match the parent value exactly. Example: "Q4" or "Q3;Q3 & Q4".
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Semicolon-separated list of Reporting Periods this option applies to (e.g., "Q4" or "Q3;Q3 & Q4"). Leave blank to always show the option.
CustomField.label: Visibility
